Question
========
Which of the following operations will append an item `x` to the end of a list `L`?

Answerlist
-----------
* `L.add(x)`
* `L.append(x)`
* `L.insert(0, x)`
* `L.extend(x)`
* `L.push(x)`
* `L + x`

Solution
========
The `.append()` method adds a single item to the end of a list.
